name: Astro-Arc
author: Garrett McDaniel
description: Reads your natal chart and the day's transits as psychology rather than symbolism. The chart first becomes a Jungian character study, written by a model forbidden any visual language; that reading is amplified into archetypes and four to seven concrete objects, one deliberately out of scale or ruined; a final pass describes them as a physical scene and never what it means. The rendered image's own colours become the theme, so wallpaper and palette always agree.
